_comment: Sample offline knowledge base for the cve-correlate module. Structure matters more than size: add real entries or refresh from the NVD API in a live engagement.

entries.description: Log4Shell: JNDI lookups in Log4j2 allow remote code execution via attacker-controlled log messages.
entries.impact: Unauthenticated remote code execution on any service that logs user input.
entries.remediation: Upgrade Log4j to 2.17.1 or later, or set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true as a stopgap.

entries.description: Apache Struts Jakarta Multipart parser remote code execution via crafted Content-Type.
entries.remediation: Upgrade Struts to 2.5.13+ and sanitise the Content-Type header.

entries.description: Spring4Shell: data binding on JDK 9+ allows modification of class loader properties leading to RCE.
entries.impact: Remote code execution on Spring MVC applications running on Tomcat.

entries.description: vBulletin 5.x pre-auth remote code execution via the widgetConfig parameter.
entries.remediation: Upgrade vBulletin and remove the routing widget handler.

entries.description: Laravel Ignition debug mode deserialisation issue leads to remote code execution.
entries.impact: Remote code execution when debug mode (APP_DEBUG=true) is enabled.
entries.remediation: Upgrade ignition to 2.5.2+ and disable APP_DEBUG in production.

entries.description: SMBGhost: integer overflow in SMBv3 compression allows remote code execution.
entries.impact: Wormable remote code execution against SMBv3 servers.
entries.remediation: Apply KB4551762 and disable SMBv3 compression.

entries.description: BlueKeep: use-after-free in Remote Desktop Services allows remote code execution.
entries.impact: Wormable, unauthenticated remote code execution on exposed RDP.
entries.remediation: Patch RDP, enable NLA, and never expose RDP directly to the internet.

entries.description: Off-by-one in the nginx resolver allows a specially crafted DNS response to overwrite memory.
entries.impact: Potential worker-process compromise or DoS in configurations using the resolver directive.

entries.description: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset: request cancellation abuse enables record-breaking DoS attacks.
entries.impact: Denial of service against HTTP/2 endpoints.
entries.remediation: Apply vendor patches and enforce stream-reset limits.
